frontmatter_snapshot.summary: 狗不叫 sells fully collateralized puts and calls to harvest premium — volatility and time-value — not to bet on direction; the ideal outcome is a flat, range-bound stock (不死不活). Strikes anchor to a fundamental floor he judges hard to break, and hard caveats travel with the practice: full collateral on both legs, no leverage, and opposition to ordinary investors touching derivatives.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Sell Premium to Harvest Volatility and Time-Value, Not Direction — 不死不活 Is the Ideal Outcome
